title: mlx-omarchy dense f32 matmul consumes Honeykrisp 8x8x8 coopmat

mlx.gate: cooperative_matrix_f32_8 && subgroup_size==32 && M,N,K % 8 == 0 && alpha==1 && no bias C && dtype float32

notes: glslang 16.4.0 asserts if coopMatLoad layout is a runtime value; branches with constant layouts are required
debugoptimized Honeykrisp aborts unless AGX2.xml exact-mask includes opcode bit6 of 0x6f
